public.description:
Are the check target URLs in the group accessible without password protection or HTTP authentication?

* `true` means they are publicly accessible
* `false` means they are protected

rules.description: Group rules that are applied to all checks in the **Group**

type.description:
Type of check. Accepted values:
  - *Plain content*: text, html, status, header, location, title, meta-description
  - *Open Graph*: meta-og:title, meta-og:description, meta-og:image, meta-og:type, meta-og:url, meta-og:site_name, meta-og:locale, meta-og:updated_time, meta-og:logo
  - *Article*: meta-article:modified_time, meta-article:published_time, meta-article:publisher, meta-article:section, meta-article:tag
  - *Twitter*: meta-twitter:title, meta-twitter:image, meta-twitter:description, meta-twitter:card, meta-twitter:site, meta-twitter:creator
  - *Item prop*: meta-itemprop:name, meta-itemprop:author, meta-itemprop:description, meta-itemprop:image

op.description:
Operators can be:
- `eq` — equal to
- `sub` — contains
- `!sub` — does not contain
- `match` — exact match
- `!match` — does not match
- `xpath` — XPath checks.

val.description: Value that will be used for the check.

templateId.description: Optional parameter if the check uses a template.

httpAuth.description: Password-protected areas may have saved HTTP authentication

period.description: Check period interval as a string (usually set to `true` - same as parent Project)

result.description: Response object (optional) show only when some some **Rules** are evaluated as an error

nextRun.description: Next run in seconds. Can be negative if we don't have new results yet.

periodInt.description: Period of automatic startup in seconds
